description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DecryptionTrait' used for decrypting data within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes abstract methods for cipher retrieval and building cipher methods, and a concrete method for decrypting data streams, handling different cipher modes like GCM.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts cipher text using provided materials, envelope metadata, and cipher options, returning a decryption stream.

methods.name: getTagFromCiphertextStream
methods.description: Extracts the authentication tag from a cipher text stream for GCM mode.

methods.name: getStrippedCiphertextStream
methods.description: Returns a stream with the cipher text minus the authentication tag.

methods.name: getDecryptingStream
methods.description: Creates a stream that decrypts data using specified cipher options, handling different cipher modes.
